welcomeSub: Track what you spend, what you earn, and stay inside your monthly limit — all on your device.
currencySub: This is how amounts will be shown across the app.
cycleSub: Choose how your month is tracked and how much you want to spend.
calendarMonthSub: Resets on the 1st of every month
customCycleSub: Resets on a day you choose — e.g. salary day
notifSub: We can remind you if you go quiet, and warn you before you hit your limit. You can change this anytime in Settings.
noTxnsSub: Tap the + button to add your first transaction.
demoBanner: Sample data added so you can try History and Insights right away.
repeatSub: Auto-fills this category & amount next cycle
aboutBody: Your data is stored only on this device. Nothing is uploaded, and no account is required.
dailyReminderSub: Nudge me if I haven't logged anything today
limitWarningsSub: Warn me at ~80% and 100% of my limit
monthlyReportSub: Remind me once a month to check my report
previewLimitTxt: You've used 82% of your August limit
previewReportTxt: Your July report is ready to view
noRecurringPending: No recurring bills waiting for confirmation.
importBody: Have a backup file from before, or one shared from another device? Choose the JSON backup file to bring those transactions back in.
exportBody: Save a copy of everything you've logged. Nothing uploads automatically — pick a backup file to keep everything safe, or a spreadsheet if you just want to browse your spending in Excel or Sheets.
exportNote: Save it to Drive, email it to yourself, or send it to Files — keep it somewhere safe in case you switch phones.
importError: That file couldn't be read — make sure it's a حساباتي backup file (.json).
importReplaceConfirm: This deletes all current transactions and replaces them with the imported file. This can't be undone. Continue?
currencyChangeBody: There's no conversion — everything you've already logged will keep displaying with its original amounts, just shown with the {{symbol}} symbol from now on. Past totals may no longer make sense next to new ones.
importSectionBody: Bring your data back from a backup file — you'll see a preview before anything is applied.
notifDailyBody: Don't forget to log today's spending.
notifMonthlyBody: Your new cycle report is ready.
devTestArmedBody: OS notification should fire around {{time}}. Verify on a real device.
